title: Never auto-play on load | UTD Shopify Themes
description:
Don't blast video or music the second someone lands. It's jarring, eats data, and on mobile it's an instant close. Let people choose to hit play. A calm, fast first impression keeps them. Ultra gets it right.
👉 Ultra on the official Shopify Theme Store: https://themes.shopify.com/themes/ultra
